title: In Russia, wherever Putin goes, gasoline prices fall
subhed: During a visit by Russian President Vladimir Putin to Krasnoyarsk, Siberia, on Monday, August 3, residents of the city were surprised to see a sudden drop in fuel prices. title: Meta ordered to pay New Mexico $567 million to abate 'public nuisance' and child harm
